about.description: sCOPX is StableStock's tokenized wrapper for the Global X Copper Miners ETF (NYSE Arca: COPX), which tracks the Solactive Global Copper Miners Total Return Index. A global basket of copper mining equities whose top holdings include Lundin Mining, Sumitomo Metal Mining, KGHM Polska Miedź, Freeport-McMoRan and Glencore. sCOPX is a BEP-20 on BNB Chain issued 1:1 against COPX units custodied off-chain through StableBroker (StableStock's licensed broker partner with HabitTrade), with 24/7 on-chain liquidity operated with Native. Mint/redeem is KYC-gated. The BEP-20 transfers freely on BSC, making copper-mining/thematic-metals exposure available inside BNB Chain DeFi.
